Answer: C
Reason: The sequential chest X-rays demonstrate the development of extensive, diffuse bilateral airspace opacities (Figures 1 and 3) followed by rapid resolution/clearing by day 4 (Figure 4a), a pattern characteristic of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) resolving with mechanical ventilation and supportive care. Pneumonia typically resolves more slowly, and cardiogenic edema usually presents with cardiomegaly which is not prominent here.
